plain.error: unsafe or irreversible proposed action; fail closed

hs_numeric_source.first_hypothesis: Unverified low-impedance or short circuit condition on the 12 V mainboard power rail or downstream power stage
hs_numeric_source.next_safe_check: Perform a completely unpowered visual inspection of the external HDMI port and exterior connectors under magnification for physical bridging, foreign debris, or bent pins while disconnected from mains power.

plain.first_hypothesis: DC jack internal mechanical switch contact oxidation or mechanical failure
plain.next_safe_check: Perform an unpowered visual inspection of the battery terminals and DC jack, followed by an unpowered continuity test across the DC jack internal switch with no external plug inserted.

hs_numeric_source.first_hypothesis: Open circuit or high contact resistance at the battery terminal contacts (e.g. surface contamination, corrosion, or mechanical deformation) preventing battery DC voltage from reaching the internal power distribution circuit.
hs_numeric_source.next_safe_check: Perform an unpowered visual inspection of the external battery compartment contacts for signs of alkaline corrosion residue, deformation, or surface contamination.
